page.layout: One scanned image: the outside of a book cover (green marbled or painted board with a dark stamp or ink device in the centre and worn patches). No printed text on the page. Several metal or paper hinges visible on the right edge.
page.notes: The scan shows the back or front board of a binding, not a printed leaf. The dark central device is an ink or tooled mark on the cover, not printed text, and is not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword, signature or text is present.
